name: Visual QA (desktop + mobile)
description: Audit an authorized app's rendered colors, responsive overflow, controls and screenshots via isolated browser sessions. Require separate authenticated E2E and visual-reference evidence for release.
prompt: Use the installed Synapse browser-ui-audit skill v0.2.1 and Completion Contract by default. Resolve the currently selected project's actual authorized app URL. Run node scripts/visual-qa.mjs <ACTUAL_URL> <NEW_REPORT_DIR> in Synapse source. Inspect JSON and screenshots at desktop, mobile and small-mobile sizes. Report measured colors, contrast candidates, overflow, errors and unnamed controls. If a disposable test account and explicit interaction scenarios are available, create a manifest and run node scripts/visual-qa-suite.mjs MANIFEST REPORT_DIR for isolated authenticated navigation, button, form, upload and visual baseline checks; never mutate real account data without authorization. Compare screenshots to approved baseline image bytes where available via ui_lab_reference_compare.py and record actual differences. Fix root causes in scope and rerun evidence. Treat timeout/untested as blocked, not passing; follow Synapse Quality OS release gates and never claim complete without proof.
